scenario: The does-not-over-fire half. `//` is floor division and yields Int, so the same shape with `//` must still compile. `100 / r.divisor` reads as integer division to anyone who has not read [LEXP.7.4].
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    divisor: Int key

schema Result scope ttl 1_h:
    val: Int

rule divide:
    Reading r
->
    emit Result val: 100 // r.divisor
